name: ItemRun
note: L_ItemTest, M3 task 04 / ADR 0004 section 10. Starts at (-2700,-1700) on the south-wall item grid and runs east over Health.Small (x -2550), Armor.Shard (-2250) and Ammo.Bullets (-1950); the next items (Health.Medium -1650, Health.Large -1350) are refused at 100+ health, so a short overshoot takes nothing else. Then stands still for 2.5 s so the replicated takes and the attribute changes arrive. infra/ci/nettest.sh runs the client with velox.items.Watch and judges the VeloxPickupPredict* and VeloxItemWatch lines.
